claim: People keep calling this the longest bear market ever, and by day count it has passed all three before it, but the rule most people use to call bull and bear says it is two separate bear markets, and the first one already ended.
why_this_claim: It is the one twist the whole video turns on, and it needs only two pictures to stand alone: the gold NOW bar passing 406, 364 and 378 (side one), and the price chart headed Two Bear Markets (side two). The short states the verdict of the rule and stops. What the rule is, the 51 days above both averages, the second leg and what Mike thinks are left for the full video, which is the reason to click.
